descriptions.description:
This note defines the falsifiability conditions governing Dimensional Human Field Theory
(DHFT). The system is falsified only if its governing structural relations fail. Variation in
expression, intensity, or empirical manifestation does not invalidate the system unless the
underlying constraints of load, capacity, boundary permeability, projection, and coupling
are violated.

https://zenodo.org/records/19093631

Full DHFT Formal System Repository: https://osf.io/9psmd/

Falsifiability and Failure Conditions

At minimum, Dimensional Human Field Theory (DHFT) is falsified if sustained increases in load under bounded capacity and non-zero boundary permeability do not produce instability, reorganization, or propagation. The system is further invalidated if dynamics reorganize solely due to interpretation, independent of structural conditions.

Additional falsification conditions include failure of propagation under permitted coupling, and failure of projection invariance—where structurally equivalent inputs produce non-equivalent outcomes across domains. Projection must preserve magnitude, direction, temporal accumulation, and structural interaction.

Variation in expression, intensity, or empirical form does not falsify the system. Only violations of invariant structural relations invalidate DHFT.

DHFT is stewarded by the Somatic Rising Institute, founded by Cara Tonucci. 

Somatic Rising Institute (SRI): 
www.somaticrisinginstitute.org
